verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique immigration law firm offering attorney-led visa and green card services, not a software product or data platform. Self-service export of user data in open formats is therefore a category error for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no product data store, account system, or export capability that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
